headline: Premier League MW7: Madueke gives Arsenal a 1-0 win at Forest
whyCareReason: Noni Madueke scored in the 80th minute. Arsenal stay three points behind City on 18.
teaser: Forest 0, Arsenal 1. AFP called it Arsenal's only shot on target. Murillo went close in stoppage time.
story: Sunday 18 October at the City Ground finished Nottingham Forest 0, Arsenal 1. Noni Madueke scored in the 80th minute. AFP reported it was Arsenal's only shot on target, and that Murillo went close in stoppage time. Half-time was 0-0. Arsenal are second on 18 points from 6 wins and 1 loss, three behind Manchester City. An earlier 2-0 line, with unnamed invented scorers, is withdrawn. Madueke told Sky: We did it all together. It was champion spirit.
stakes: Three points keep Arsenal on 18, three behind City on 21. Forest are 18th on 5 points.
rivalryAngle: A title-chasing side took one goal from a single shot on target.
funFacts: AFP: Arsenal's only shot on target. Murillo went close in stoppage time.
Arsenal 18 points (6-0-1), 11 for and 5 against. City lead on 21.
